0.rule: U-like iff min(p80,p160) < p0 AND p320 > that mid-best; else monotonic if the five-point sequence is monotone and the endpoint differs from iter0; else flat if all vs-iter0 CIs include 0 (or |Δ|<0.05 without CIs); else other.
